text: This solution, Philippine City Disaster Insurance Pool (PCDIP) addresses natural catastrophe through public private partnerships in Republic of the Philippines between Department of Finance (DOF), Bureau of the Treasury (BTr), Government Service Insurance System (GSIS), cities/local government units (LGUs), Asian Development Bank (ADB), Asia-Pacific Climate Finance Fund (ACliFF), InsuResilience Global Partnership, SEADRIF Insurance Company, Global Shield initiative, and International reinsurance market. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration and regulation.
